sources.finding: Alpaca CTA/UTP quote quantities use shares from 2025-11-03; earlier quantities use round lots.

findings: Historical quote responses reference stock_quote; both quantities explicitly distinguish shares after 2025-11-03 from earlier round lots.
The timestamp schema specifies RFC3339 nanosecond format but does not identify SIP, participant or strategy receipt time.
One quote condition applies to both sides; with two, the first is bid and second ask. Zero price denotes an inactive side.

Optional stock_trade.u describes current record cancellation/incorrect/corrected status; absent is valid under the current API record semantics. It does not provide delivery time, linkage or an as-observed correction sequence.
Trade ID is exchange supplied, not a documented universal event sequence.

sources.finding: UTP sizes changed from lots to shares on 2025-11-03; round-lot tiers are 100/40/10/1, assigned semiannually from primary-listing evaluation prices.
First reassignment took effect 2026-05-01. Current symbol reference files cannot establish the historical May mapping.
CTA changed quote sizes to shares on 2025-11-03. Its daily symbol reference supplies lot size; quote quantity conversion for May 2026 does not require multiplying by that lot size.
Historical SIP quotes sorted by symbol and timestamp; equal-clock event order is not specified; inclusive end and pagination tokens must be handled explicitly.
